lane_title: Skill Registry / Agent Skills Security Oracle
purpose: CP5 adversarial compatibility oracle for the future Skill Registry importer and safety-inheritance gate. Defines hostile skill packages and manifests, the stage where each must be caught, the required verdict, and what must never happen. Any vector left unguarded by the CP5 importer/registry is a candidate Integration FAIL per the fail_oracle list.

vector_shape.category: one of the categories listed above
vector_shape.fixture: concrete hostile input, with an on-disk copy under the fixture corpus where filesystem-safe
vector_shape.attack_goal: what the attacker is trying to achieve
vector_shape.expected_stage: registry phase that must produce the verdict: IMPORT_PARSE | NAME_VALIDATION | MANIFEST_VALIDATION | VERSION_RESOLUTION | CAPABILITY_BINDING | SAFETY_INHERITANCE | ELIGIBILITY | SNAPSHOT | INSPECT_RENDER | STORE_COMMIT | REGISTRY_QUERY
vector_shape.expected_result: verdict: PASS | REJECT | FAIL_CLOSED | SKILL_VERSION_CONFLICT | INERT | BLOCKED | DISPLAY_ONLY | CONTAINED (compound tokens such as REJECT_OR_CONTAIN, REJECT_OR_IGNORE, REJECT_OR_BOUNDED, REJECT_OR_NORMALIZE, REJECT_OR_SKIP_LINK, REJECT_OR_SANITIZE, REJECT_OR_CANONICAL, REJECT_OR_STRIP, REJECT_OR_COMPUTE_ON_IMPORT, REJECT_OR_PARSE_IDENTICAL, REJECT_OR_SEPARATE_NAMESPACE, FAIL_CLOSED_OR_LONG_PATH, PASS_SINGLE_MANIFEST, PASS_IDEMPOTENT, PASS_IDEMPOTENT_OR_CONFLICT, EXACT_ONE_BLOCK document a bounded acceptance rule the importer must implement)
vector_shape.expected_error: machine-readable error code the failed verdict must surface; none when the vector must pass
vector_shape.must_not_happen: outcome that converts this vector into an Integration FAIL
vector_shape.automatable: true when a deterministic integration test can assert the verdict

safety_inheritance_canonical_defaults.note: capability registry owns the canonical posture per capability (risk, evidence, conflict_policy, verification, freshness); a skill manifest may only tighten (equal or stricter), never loosen

fail_oracle: unknown safety manifest key silently accepted
